summary: Sub-1 GHz (315/433/868/915 MHz bands) FSK/GFSK/ASK/OOK/MSK transceiver, up to +12 dBm; 4-wire SPI slave plus GDO0/GDO2 general outputs (IRQ/FIFO status); 26-27 MHz crystal with external load caps; 1.8-3.6 V; no reset pin (reset by SRES strobe). Differential RF_P/RF_N need a band-specific balun and LC filter (inductors) that this entry does NOT model, so node:rf is not fab-ready until that network is added
